intents_zh: k8s 同時看多 pod log
code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

pods=$(kubectl get pods -l "{{label_selector}}" -o name)
[ -z "$pods" ] && { echo "no pods match"; exit 1; }

colors=(31 32 33 34 35 36)
i=0
for p in $pods; do
  c=${colors[$((i % 6))]}
  name=${p#pod/}
  ( kubectl logs -f "$p" --tail=20 --all-containers 2>&1 \
    | sed -u "s/^/\x1b[${c}m[$name]\x1b[0m /" ) &
  i=$((i+1))
done
trap 'kill 0' EXIT
wait
summary_zh: 依 label 並行 follow 多 pod log 加色
